claims.claim: Eligible PRIMARY candidate deltas run first, bounded to 64 exact identities and one quarter of candidate collection. Reproduced failures block; passing or ineligible probes retain the authored requirement. Unavailable, unstable, conflicting or incomparable collection truth falls back safely.
Correction operations probe validly bound previous failed identities before covering commands. Persistent failure stops immediately; probe success retains broader authored proof.

Eligible broad pytest failures use exact candidate reproduction and base attribution. Exact base PASS remains regression; matching failure details and fingerprints remain required for baseline attribution. Reproduced identities absent from exact base collection produce candidate-only blocking attribution without broad base replay.
Projection non-reproduction, changed phases or details, collection disagreement, malformed observations and execution-condition mismatches use broader attribution or remain blocking.

The implementation retains minimum-sufficient-v2, authored full-suite guards, complete failure populations, exact bindings and conservative reuse. Early probes have no authored proof authority. Generated Windows probes preserve literal parameterized identities through direct argv transport.

Regression coverage includes five candidate-only failures with 796/776 collections and no broad base replay, passing deltas, correction failure-first ordering, projection non-reproduction and broad fallback.

The committed changes modify only the six permitted verification and regression files and introduce no policy version, semantic dependency inference, lifecycle authority, roadmap mutation, TASK-313 semantic change or focused-parallel redesign.
